channel.title: The FLYLYFE Journal
channel.description: House music culture, NYC streetwear history, and style guides from FLYLYFE.

item.title: The Argentina World Cup 'Conspiracy,' Explained
item.description: Is the World Cup rigged for Argentina? The claims vs the record — 1978, the Hand of God, 2022 penalties and VAR, and the 2026 final Argentina lost.

item.title: What Does "Las Malvinas Son Argentinas" Mean? The World Cup Banner, Explained
item.description: What does "Las Malvinas son argentinas" mean? The 1982 war, Maradona, the Muchachos song, and the 2026 World Cup banner and FIFA case, explained.

item.title: NYC House Music History: Where Garage House Was Born
item.description: NYC house music history, from David Mancuso's Loft to Larry Levan's Paradise Garage — where garage house was born and how it shapes streetwear.

item.title: The Best House Music T-Shirts (2026)
item.description: A ranked roundup of FLYLYFE's best house-music tees, led by The House Music Tee, The Anthem Tee and The Soul Tee — $49.99 each, printed to order in the USA.

item.title: Gifts for House Music Lovers & DJs (2026)
item.description: A house music gift guide by persona — the DJ, the dancer, the purist, the NYC head, the minimalist — with real FLYLYFE tees to match, from $39.99.

item.title: What Is House Music? A Head's Guide to the Sound, the Origins, and the Spirit
item.description: What is house music? A head's guide to its 1980s Chicago origins, Frankie Knuckles, the four-on-the-floor beat, subgenres, and its spiritual pull.

item.title: NYC House Music Streetwear: The Culture Behind the Cotton
item.description: NYC house music streetwear traces a line from Paradise Garage loft nights to today's dark-and-gold tees. See how FLYLYFE turns that lineage into cotton.

item.title: NYC Subway Token History: From a 1953 Fare Hike to a City Icon
item.description: NYC subway token history: how a 1953 fare hike created the brass coin, why it became a New York icon, and how it retired in 2003 for the MetroCard.

item.title: What to Wear to a House Music Festival: The Streetwear Outfit Guide
item.description: A house music festival outfit guide: breathable heavyweight graphic tees, day-to-night layers, supportive sneakers, and practical tips to dance all night.

item.title: How to Style a Graphic Tee So It Actually Looks Intentional
item.description: How to style a graphic tee that holds its shape: tuck vs untuck, layering, and footwear for heavyweight garment-dyed cotton, made for NYC day to night.
